ular chemistry. Specifically, we study GO-MACE-23, a model designed for the extended
covalent network of graphene oxide, and quantify its zero-shot performance for small,
isolated molecules and chemical reactions outside its direct scope—in direct compari-
son with a state-of-the-art model which has been trained in-domain. Our work provides
